conventions.coordinates: inputs are decimal STRINGS with at most two decimals and are read exactly (never through a float); exact values are written "p/q" or "p"
conventions.quadrants: Q1 x>0,y>0; Q2 x<0,y>0; Q3 x<0,y<0; Q4 x>0,y<0; a point with a zero coordinate is 'axis-x' (y=0, x!=0), 'axis-y' (x=0, y!=0) or 'origin' and is in NO quadrant
conventions.distances: distToYAxis = |x|, distToXAxis = |y|; distance = sqrt(dx^2+dy^2) as a*b^(1/2)/c with b square-free (gcd(a,c)=1, c>0)
conventions.pixels: img[row, col] with row 0 at the top: col = x, row = H-1-y, index = row*W+col; (x, y) is the lattice point at the centre of the pixel cell

tolerance.rationale: Math.sqrt is correctly rounded from the nearest double to the squared distance (<= 1 ulp from the true root). Exact forms, positions, differences, midpoints, taxicab values and pixel indices must match EXACTLY.
